subject: Career Fair
question: Suppose you love designing smart medical wearables that measure heart rate and alert doctors via mobile apps. Which engineering combination aligns best?
options: Electronics/Embedded Sensors + Programming/Mobile App Development + Biomedical/AI Signal Processing
Medieval poetry translation without electronics or software
Brick masonry without sensors, circuits, or code
Avoiding both hardware and software entirely

explanation.why: Modern products blend disciplines: ECE sensors capture biological signals, CSE/programming builds the app and cloud pipeline, and AI cleans noisy signals.
explanation.commonTrap: You don't have to pick only one narrow box—modern engineering teams combine branches!

subject: Career Fair
question: Which habits in your first year of engineering build a strong launchpad for internships and careers? (Select all that apply)
options: Writing small working code or hardware projects outside class assignments
Using Git/version control and documenting projects cleanly
Collaborating with peers in technical clubs, hackathons, or build teams
Waiting until final semester placement week to open an IDE or lab kit

explanation.why: Small consistent projects, version-controlled portfolios, and peer collaboration compound rapidly over four college years.
explanation.shortcut: Build small -> Commit to Git -> Collaborate in clubs -> Iterate early.
explanation.commonTrap: Degrees alone open fewer doors than degrees backed by demonstrable skills and real builds.

subject: Career Fair
question: Match each pathway term in List I to what it unlocks in List II.

right: Tamil Nadu state B.E./B.Tech admission via Class 12 PCM cutoff
M.Tech / PhD admissions and many PSU engineering recruitments
Primary gateway to IIT undergraduate B.Tech programs
National gateway to NITs, IIITs, GFTIs & qualifier for JEE Advanced

explanation.why: Each exam/counseling system maps to a distinct stage: JEE Main (NIT/IIIT/GFTI), JEE Advanced (IIT), TNEA (TN state B.E./B.Tech), and GATE (postgrad/PSUs).
explanation.shortcut: UG National: JEE Main -> JEE Adv | UG TN State: TNEA | PG/PSU: GATE.
explanation.commonTrap: Parents and students often confuse JoSAA (central counseling) with state processes like TNEA.

subject: Career Fair
question: In 1999, NASA's Mars Climate Orbiter was lost because one software module output force in pound-seconds while another expected SI newton-seconds. What engineering lesson does this prove?
options: Explicit SI units, interface specifications, and integration testing are mission-critical
Unit labels can safely be omitted in aerospace code to save memory
Only mechanical hardware needs testing; software never needs checks
Imperial and metric units always share identical numerical values

explanation.why: Every interface between two engineering subsystems must define exact physical units and be verified by automated integration tests.
explanation.shortcut: Always check units at subsystem boundaries (N·s ≠ lbf·s).
explanation.commonTrap: Even mathematically 'correct' code fails catastrophically when two teams assume different units.

subject: Career Fair
question: If you are excited by designing EV battery packs, solar microgrids, and high-efficiency motors, which engineering path fits best?
options: Electrical (EEE) / Power Electronics combined with Mechanical thermal design
None — electric grids require zero engineering

explanation.why: Clean energy and electric mobility sit at the intersection of Electrical Engineering (power converters, batteries, grids) and Mechanical Engineering (cooling and packaging).
explanation.shortcut: EVs & Grids = Electrical Power Electronics + Mechanical Thermal Systems.
explanation.commonTrap: EEE is no longer just traditional substations—it drives EVs, robotics power, and renewables.

subject: Career Fair
question: True or False: Because engineering tools and frameworks evolve rapidly, strong problem-solving fundamentals and continuous learning matter more over a 30-year career than memorizing one tool.
options: True — fundamentals let engineers adapt across new languages, hardware, and AI tools
False — whatever software tool you learn in Semester 1 never changes for 30 years

explanation.why: Tools, frameworks, and libraries change every few years, whereas math, physics, algorithms, circuits, and structured debugging remain timeless superpowers.
explanation.shortcut: Tools change fast; physics, math, and systems thinking endure.
explanation.commonTrap: Chasing only syntax trends without understanding core systems leaves engineers fragile when stacks evolve.
